title: Runs from a halted configuration are constant
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input whose state is absent, so that the machine is halted. For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, running $M$ for $n$ steps from $c$ yields $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration on a fixed input with no state
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and $c$ a configuration whose state
component is empty (the machine has halted).  Then running $M$ for any number
of steps from $c$ yields $c$ itself.
